chunks.text:

chunks.title: Determining your residency status
chunks.text:
Tax residency depends on the full circumstances, including residential connections, the purpose and continuity of a stay, and relevant tax treaties. The CRA provides residency guidance and forms for requesting its opinion when entering or leaving Canada. A permit category, city or arrival date is not enough for VERA to decide residency.
Source excerpt: Under the Canadian income tax system, your income tax obligations to Canada are based on your residency status.
